**Get it on [Nexus Mods](https://www.nexusmods.com/cardealersimulator/mods/59)**, or download `LukasMods-CDS-InstalledMods-1.0.zip` below. It's the same archive as the one on Nexus, byte for byte: sha256 `19c7be79f5d4e54d02ae407ef9e6f156551c249eb8a3b070ac563441879054b0`.

See your installed UE4SS mods and switch them on or off from the game's title menu. Installed Mods adds an INSTALLED MODS button just above QUIT; there's no tablet or office-computer app.

Needs Car Dealer Simulator on PC (Steam) and an EXPERIMENTAL UE4SS build, 3.0.1 experimental `44afb36d`, the same as Parts Manager. Copy the `InstalledMods` folder into `<game folder>\CarDealerSimulator\Binaries\Win64\ue4ss\Mods\`, or install it with Vortex. Install and full details: [Installed Mods guide](https://github.com/lukas-mods/Lukas-Mods/blob/main/guides/car-dealer-simulator/installed-mods.md).

> ⚠️ **Use at Your Own Risk.** Any mod can crash a game or damage a save, so back up your saves first: copy `%LOCALAPPDATA%\CarDealerSimulator\Saved\` somewhere safe.

## 1.0 - First Release

- An INSTALLED MODS button on the title menu, just above QUIT, opens a list of your UE4SS mods: name, on or off, and version when the mod gives one. UE4SS's built-in mods are left out.
- Turn mods on or off, then press Apply. Changes take effect the next time you start the game, and a box offers to quit now.
- It changes only a mod's enabled.txt, and only when you press Apply. Mods switched in mods.txt show "(set in mods.txt)" and have no switch.
- Report a Bug and Request a Feature buttons open GitHub's forms in your browser. The bug report lists your mods and holds no file paths.
- Removing Installed Mods doesn't undo your switches: a mod you switched off stays off.
